NONE: C1 moving towards a higher position, level, or value
向上的，朝上的；向高處的

example: With an upward trend in inflation, you expect prices to rise.
通貨膨脹有上升趨勢，預計物價還會上漲。

NONE: C2 If you say something is upward(s) of a number or value, you mean it is at least the stated amount and probably more.

example: Upwards of 50,000 people assembled in the main square.
五萬多人聚集在主廣場上。

NONE: › moving or able to move to a higher social class, for example by becoming richer

example: The meeting attracted upwardly mobile professional and political women.
這次會議吸引了向上發展的職業女性和政界女性。

NONE: C1 towards a higher position, level, or value

example: She turned her face upwards to the sun.
她抬頭面向正午的太陽。
The cost of completion has been revised upwards again due to inflation.
由於通貨膨脹，完工的費用再次調高。

NONE: › in the direction from which the wind is blowing
在上風處（地）；逆風（地），頂風（地）

example: Stay upwind of the fumes if you can.
盡可能呆在煙霧的上風口。
